failure_classes: English idiomatic How is ... doing? was not classified as an action-state query after correct plural reference resolution

product_repairs_after_first_exposure: classify bounded how-is/how-are doing/going questions as action-state queries
keep quoted grammar, syntax, wording, phrase, sentence, and expression analysis outside the world-action ledger

mechanisms: DiscourseGroupIR now carries a stable group identity, monotonic revision, component parent IDs, and a membership hash bound to type, members, topics, revision, parents, and introduction turn.
AddMember and RemoveMember revise one existing group in place; validation recomputes the exact before-to-after set relation and rejects rehashed substitutions.
MergeGroups creates a new composite identity from two same-kind existing parents, deduplicates overlapping members, and rejects a cached union that differs from the live parents.
DiscourseGroupUpdateIR is a separate non-authoritative, non-executing record; group edits do not become semantic concepts, action plans, or execution results.
Composite groups are valid only while both immediate parent identities exist, and merge is rejected rather than evicting a required parent at the bounded group limit.
Quoted group-edit language has no update authority, and a metalinguistic request about a quoted sentence is not inserted into the world-action ledger.
English idiomatic group-state questions preserve the already resolved plural action IDs instead of falling back to an empty target set.

strongest_axes: typed plan, report, observation, and verified-result separation
tamper-evident discourse state and evidence-grounded realization
language_level_assessment.largest_remaining_gap: open-domain pragmatic and world-knowledge generalization together with varied natural realization

residual_limits: This remains bounded deterministic language engineering and does not establish GPT-level open-domain language competence.
Group revision uses controlled Korean and English surfaces, a maximum of eight live groups, existing ledger or attributed-source members, and a sixteen-turn reference horizon.
Composite identity records immediate parents; arbitrary nested composite algebra, parent archival, and durable restoration after eviction are not implemented.
Metalinguistic requests are authority-safe but their natural explanatory answer quality remains limited by the current realization and knowledge layers.
Open vocabulary, unrestricted syntax, broad cultural implicature, and freely varied humanlike expression remain unverified.
next_program_order: topic suspension restoration and revision across persistent and composite groups
broader typed deixis and ellipsis over revised composite discourse objects
compositional speech-intent and pragmatic inference with ambiguity preservation

more natural evidence-grounded realization with claim-level support checks
